goal: Name the single most valuable improvement EXCAVA could make to how it presents results to its owner, and say concretely what to change.

judge.said:
ARTIFACT 2

The winner is more concrete and actionable because it specifies exact deliverables (e.g., "Executive Summary," traffic-light system, one-click links) and step-by-step improvements.
